title: Roy Palmer brings him a brass horn
summary: After two summers Roy Palmer brought him a horn, which he polished with brass polish and started fooling with.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: No, I don't know this guitar player either because he was a very sensible fellow. He didn't drink and he didn't smoke, you see. And he tried to carry the band on straight. Well, I kept that place going for two summers. And after then I started playing music. Roy Palmer brought me a horn. And the first thing that I did, Roy brought the horn by there about eight o'clock that night. And it was brass. And the greatest thing that I wanted to see, that horn shine. So I just waited until the next day and brought me some brass polish for my horses that I used, my mules on the polish. And I polish that come home and polish that horn up. And run some water through it. And fool around with it a little while. After a while I committed to getting sensible to it.
